## Rule

Fixed 10x10 generator (`task_ddf7fa4f`). Top row contains exactly three non-gray marker
colors in light columns `[0..2]`, `[4..5]`, and `[7..9]`. The grid contains three
non-overlapping gray (color 5) rectangles, each width 2-5, and each rectangle lies under
exactly one marker column. Recolor every gray cell in each rectangle to that marker color;
all top-row marker cells and background cells are preserved.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
out = zeros_like(inp)
out[0] = inp[0]
for each gray rectangle run/row:
    marker_col = the top-row non-gray column contained by the run
    out[gray_run_cells] = inp[0, marker_col]
```

ONNX rewrite uses a scalar-label canvas rather than a 10-channel crop: extract top-row
color indices with one `Einsum`, slice color-5 as a 10x10 mask, propagate marker
labels horizontally with four masked `MaxPool` rounds (width<=5 proves distance<=4),
restore the top-row labels, then emit the required 10-channel tensor through a final
uncharged one-hot expansion.

## Cost analysis

LIVE cost 14,135 is dominated by a full 10-channel F32 crop (4,000 B), F16 crop (2,000 B),
F16 one-hot intermediate (2,000 B), and INT64 label maps (3 x 800 B). The scalar-label
rewrite avoids the full crop and original-label extraction because non-gray non-background
cells exist only in the top row.

Measured v1 score: `(macs=0, memory=3980, params=85, cost=4065)`, below the prompt target
of 30% of LIVE (4,240.5).

Measured v3 score: `(macs=0, memory=2580, params=82, cost=2662)`. The main savings over
v1 are U8 flood carriers (100 B per 10x10 plane instead of 200 B F16), U8 Equal-tail
(`labels -> Pad(sentinel=10) -> Equal(ch_ids) == output`) so the final 10-channel output is
uncharged, and `ScatterElements` to restore top markers without a full 10x10 `top_labels`
plane. Largest remaining honest tensors are `labels30` U8 `[1,1,30,30]` = 900 B,
`mask5_f32` = 400 B, and the exact four masked radius-1 propagation rounds = 800 B.

Measured v7 score: `(macs=0, memory=2450, params=47, cost=2497)`. The only semantic change
from v3 is top marker extraction: `Conv(input, color_w, pads=[0,0,-29,-20])` emits
`[1,1,1,10]` directly. This removes the `[1,30]` top-color projection, the `[1,10]`
slice, and the top-row `Unsqueeze`; full truth and A/B are byte-equal to v3.

Measured v12 score: `(macs=0, memory=2450, params=45, cost=2495)`, and gate-5
`profile_real_cost.py --arcgen 266` reports `static=2495 profile=2495`. It is the same
strict v7 graph with the final opset-18 `Pad` using an `axes=[2,3]` input, so the pad
initializer is `[0,0,20,20]` plus two axes params instead of the rank-4 8-value pad vector.
Dominant charged tensors remain `labels30` U8 900 B, `mask5_f32` 400 B, and eleven 100 B
U8 mask/reach/dilation/label planes. Current floor pressure is therefore semantic, not a
Pad accounting issue: removing a flood gate, merging larger pools, or dropping the 30x30
contract has already failed visible or ORT/runtime gates.

## Don't-do log

- Do not keep the fifth horizontal flood round: generator width is <=5, so max distance
  from the marker column to a rectangle edge is <=4. Full truth and AB passed with four
  rounds.
- Do not rebuild a full 10-channel cropped F16 canvas before padding. The BOOL `Equal`
  tail costs 1,000 B and the final BOOL `Pad` output is uncharged.
- Do not extract original labels for the whole 10x10 crop. The generator has no non-gray
  non-background cells outside the top marker row.
- Do not use larger horizontal kernels (`safe2x5`, `risk1x9`, mixed 3-pass schedules):
  one-cell gaps between same-row rectangles allow color to jump into the neighboring
  rectangle. Visible probes failed (examples: `safe2x5` 84/266, `risk1x9` 43/266,
  `probe3_333_eqtail` 257/266).
- The same larger-kernel warning still holds after the v7 top-conv tail. Single-pass
  `v8_topconv_pool_{5,7,9}` all score 1,897 but fail visible (111/266, 74/266, 43/266).
  Do not stage them: they are exactly the gap-jump failure mode, just below 2k.
- Do not skip any of the four radius-1 mask gates. `v10_topconv_maskafter_{123,023,013,012}`
  all score 2,397 but fail visible (154/266, 98/266, 84/266, 0/266). One-cell gaps let
  labels leak before the next mask can suppress them.
- Do not seed the top marker color one column left/right to save the fourth full round.
  It scores under 2500 locally (`v5_topdil3`, cost 2472) but false-seeds adjacent
  rectangles and fails visible (195/266; reversed-code variant 197/266).
- Do not stage visible-failing "risk" candidates for this task. The class is deterministic
  and visible failures are guaranteed zero-score signals, not useful submit probes.
- Do not rely on data-dependent Pad-size cost fiction here. The dynamic-pad probe returned
  no local score and crashed visible with ORT shape/buffer mismatch.
- The top-conv dynamic-pad retry (`v11_topconv_dynamicpad_risk`) does get a local dummy
  score of 1,786 by declaring the cheap 10x10 output shape, but visible crashes at the Pad
  node with `{1,1,10,10} != {1,1,30,30}`. Do not stage it.
- Do not omit the final 30x30 output contract. `v6_u8_active10_equal` scores locally at
  1,753 because it drops the `labels30` pad, but visible is 0/266: the gate compares raw
  `[1,10,30,30]` one-hot tensors, not decoded/trimmed 10x10 grids.
- Do not pursue a BitwiseAnd set-intersection final unless it also solves raw one-hot value
  normalization and channel-0 background. Two bits can represent rectangle-vs-top support,
  but raw verification expects exact value 1, and booleanizing the full tensor would make
  the 30x30 output an intermediate.
- Do not pursue the direct Path-A `QLinearConv` mask crop from the official F32 input. ONNX
  requires `QLinearConv` input `x` to be quantized (`UINT8`/`INT8`); an F32 `x` with matching
  zero point passes shape inference but fails checker with unsupported `tensor(float)`.
  Quantizing after the 10x10 `Slice` keeps the charged 400 B F32 crop, while quantizing the
  full input is much larger than the saved mask carrier.
- Do not rely on a single broadcast-comparison final for this task. It can express a
  foreground channel as "rectangle plus top marker" by ordered column thresholds, but
  channel 0 is the active 10x10 background with multiple rectangular holes and is not one
  nested row/column comparison family.
- A low-rank renderer with row/column rectangle factors is not currently useful as a lower
  exact route. `v9_i8_lowrank_einsum` constructs exact factors using 1-D column propagation,
  but ORT has no `Einsum(INT8)` implementation, and the static factor-building memory is
  already 2,900 bytes before switching the final contraction to float.
- The Task312/#68 per-row color-map contraction does not transfer. Probe
  `prototypes/probe_task354_v12_colormap_discriminator.py` checked single 5->color maps
  at grid, row, and column granularity. Results: official visible grid-level fails
  266/266, row-level fails 263/266, column-level fails 91/266; 200k corpus grid-level
  fails 200000/200000, row-level fails 196992/200000, column-level fails 60798/200000.
  A Task312-style `Einsum('v,bkhv,kcd,bchw->bdhw', ...)` needs one selected map per
  row/grid/column; task354 needs cell/run connectivity, so this re-enters the flood/label
  problem rather than replacing it.
- Do not chase the stale `best_ext_cost=110` / `kmmmvs_local_best` artifact for this task.
  It is a one-node Conv-style scorer-cheap false lead: score `(0, 0, 110)`, visible
  `0/266`.
- Do not replace the four-round masked flood with a dense #110 segmented row LUT or
  interval-mask broadcast. Full visible+ARC-GEN audit: single maps still fail
  grid `266/266`, row `263/266`, column `91/266`, and gray runs touch fixed gap columns
  3 or 6 in 1,063 rows. The minimal dense segmented LUT has `8 * 1024 = 8192` entries
  before color transport; the interval-mask route needs at least a 3,200 B INT32
  `BitwiseAnd` broadcast plus 800 B of BOOL predicates, both above the current 800 B
  four-round propagation budget.
- Worker-10 fixed-band refresh over 200k confirms this is not only a gap-column issue:
  columns 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 each require multiple marker slots across the corpus, core
  light bands are violated in 143,863/200,000 pairs, and the best fixed per-column
  slot map still misses 89,340/200,000 pairs.
- Do not chase the rank-3 label-path Pad shrink unless it removes an existing tensor too:
  squeezing or reshaping the current rank-4 mask/top-label path adds at least one 100 B
  tensor to save only two Pad params.
